name: File Transformation
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of File Transformation 3.0.0 (upstream: IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-file-transformation).
description: Allows other plugins to intercept and change the delivered web content of jellyfin-web. This build targets Jellyfin 12.4 (net10.0); source changes are limited to the JellyfinVersion bump (csproj property + assembly attribute).

versions.changelog: Rebuilt against Jellyfin 12.4.0 packages (net10.0). No functional changes vs upstream 3.0.0.

name: Jellyframe
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of JellyFrame 1.5.3 (upstream: Jellyfin-PG/JellyFrame).
description: A complete customization and extension framework for Jellyfin: community mods and themes from the dashboard, plus a server-side JavaScript API. Requires the File Transformation plugin. This build targets Jellyfin 12.4 (net10.0, Jellyfin.Controller/Model 12.4.0) and fixes the three 12.4 API breaks (IPlaylistManager.AddItemToPlaylistAsync signature, IUserManager.ResetPassword(Guid), IUserManager.Users removed).

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation: net10.0 + Jellyfin.Controller/Model 12.4.0 + Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 10.0.12; fixed AddItemToPlaylistAsync/ResetPassword/GetUsers API breaks in JellyfinSurface.

name: Media Bar Enhanced
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of Media Bar Enhanced 3.12 (upstream: CodeDevMLH/jellyfin-plugin-media-bar-enhanced).
description: Featured content slideshow bar for the Jellyfin home page: backdrops, logos, ratings, plot, play button, trailer autoplay. Per-library include/exclude, excluded genres/tags, item limits. Requires the File Transformation plugin (install it from this repository first).

versions.changelog: Rebuilt against Jellyfin 12.4.0 packages (net10.0). Configuration page localized to Simplified Chinese (zh-CN).

name: Home Screen Sections
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of Home Screen Sections 3.0.0 (upstream: IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-home-sections), with zh-CN localization pack added.
description: Adds server-provided dynamic home screen sections (Because You Watched, Latest, Discover, Upcoming with *arr integration...). This build targets Jellyfin 12.4 (net10.0) and adds a complete Simplified Chinese translation pack (224 keys). Requires the File Transformation plugin.

versions.changelog: NEW: global library scope - a checkbox list under Global Settings limits item-based sections (Latest, Discover, Genre, Decade, Studio, Because You Watched, Hidden Gems, Watch Again, Recently Added in Library...) to the selected libraries. User-activity and external sections (Continue Watching, Next Up, My List, Collections, Upcoming, Requests, Live TV) are exempt by design. Empty selection = all libraries.

name: Collection Sections
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of Collection Sections 3.0.0 (upstream: IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-collection-sections), config page localized to zh-CN.
description: Adds collection/playlist sections to the home screen via the Home Screen Sections plugin. Requires Home Screen Sections.

versions.changelog: Rebuilt (upstream csproj already targets 12.4.0/net10.0); config page localized to zh-CN.

name: Custom Tabs
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of Custom Tabs 0.3.0 (upstream: IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-custom-tabs), config page localized to zh-CN.
description: Adds custom tabs to the jellyfin-web title bar. Requires the File Transformation plugin.

versions.changelog: Rebuilt against Jellyfin 12.4.0 (net10.0); config page localized to zh-CN.

name: Plugin Pages
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of Plugin Pages 3.0.0 (upstream: IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-pages).
description: Allows plugins to add pages to the main UI that match the native look. Requires the File Transformation plugin.

name: EditorsChoice
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of Editors Choice 1.6.2 (upstream: lachlandcp/jellyfin-editors-choice-plugin), config page localized to zh-CN.
description: Adds a Netflix-style full-width featured content slider to the home screen. Requires the File Transformation plugin.

versions.changelog: NEW: library scope picker on the config page (was missing upstream: the LibraryList container was never rendered and only movies/tvshows libraries were listed). Now lists all library types incl. mixed, applies to all modes. Rebuilt against Jellyfin 12.4.0 (net10.0); zh-CN config page.

name: Jellyfin Enhanced
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of Jellyfin Enhanced 12.14 (upstream: n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced), admin settings page localized to zh-CN.
description: A comprehensive enhancement layer for the Jellyfin web UI: poster quality tags, richer detail pages, better player, shortcuts, spoiler guard, requests, calendar and admin tools. This build is rebuilt for Jellyfin 12.4 (net10.0) with the admin configuration page localized to Simplified Chinese. Note: the user-facing Enhanced panel (? key) remains in English. Requires the File Transformation plugin.

versions.changelog: Rebuilt against Jellyfin 12.4 (net10.0, AssemblyVersion 12.14.0.1); admin config page (~1000 strings) localized to zh-CN; no functional changes vs upstream 12.14.0.0.

name: Intro Skipper
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of Intro Skipper (upstream: intro-skipper/intro-skipper, 12.0 branch), dashboard UI localized to zh-CN.
description: Automatically detect and skip intro/credit sequences. Built from the upstream 12.0 branch (code level 12.0.6.1) with the TypeScript dashboard translated to Simplified Chinese.

versions.changelog: Built from upstream 12.0 branch @ 2026-10-31; dashboard web UI (tabs/components, ~200 strings) localized to zh-CN; tsc + vite + dotnet build all clean.

name: InPlayerEpisodePreview
overview: Jellyfin 12.4 adaptation build of In-Player Episode Preview 2.5.0 (upstream: Namo2/InPlayerEpisodePreview), config page localized to zh-CN.
description: Displays a preview of episodes/other content while browsing or during playback. Rebuilt against Jellyfin 12.4 (net10.0) with the admin config page localized to Simplified Chinese. Requires the File Transformation plugin for injection.

versions.changelog: Rebuilt against Jellyfin 12.4.0 (net10.0); config page + popup group label localized to zh-CN.
